gloss: faction; clique; gang (with a negative nuance)

definitions.explanation: A group of people who band together to pursue a common — usually questionable or harmful — purpose. The word carries clearly negative connotations: secrecy, factionalism, plotting against others. Most commonly heard in the set phrase {徒党|ととう}を{組|く}む ('to form a faction').

examples.japanese: {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They formed a clique and attacked the opposing faction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かしている→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Rumors are spreading that a particular faction within the company has formed a clique and is manipulating personnel decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{悪徳|あくとく}→悪徳：29368_akutoku⟧⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{役人|やくにん}→役人：12611_yakunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み→組む：02050_kumu⟧、⟦{庶民|しょみん}→庶民：12427_shomin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{苦|くる}しめる→苦しめる：01939_kurushimeru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{描|えが}かれる→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: Historical dramas often depict scenes in which corrupt merchants and officials band together as a clique and torment ordinary people.

notes:
Composed of {徒|と} ('group, set of people') + {党|とう} ('party, faction'). Both characters refer to grouping; the compound emphasizes a band of people working together for shared (and often illegitimate) ends.

USAGE:
- The word almost always appears in the set phrase {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ ('to form a clique / band together') or in the compound noun {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧〜 ('a faction-organized 〜'). Standalone use is rare.
- Strongly negative: implies conspiracy, factionalism, or ganging up on someone. Avoid using {徒党|ととう} for neutral groups (use ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧, ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧, or ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ instead).
- Common in journalism, historical drama, and political commentary; less so in everyday conversation, where グル ('to be in cahoots') or {結託|けったく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to collude') often appears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a clique; to band together
- {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{連中|れんちゅう}→連中：14372_renchuu⟧: a band of people / clique members
- {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead a faction
- {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}する→解散する：21678_kaisansuru⟧: to disband a clique
- ⟦{悪|あく}→悪：10459_aku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徒党|ととう}: a band of villains

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧: faction (within a political party or organization) — neutral institutional term; describes formal subgroups, not necessarily conspiratorial.
- ⟦{一味|いちみ}→一味：11238_ichimi⟧: a gang; a group (of accomplices) — also negative; emphasizes shared guilt, often used for criminal groups.
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companions; group — neutral or positive; used for friends, colleagues, or fellow members.
- {結託|けったく}: collusion; conspiring — describes the act of secretly cooperating, often as a verb pair to {徒党|ととう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧.
- グル: in cahoots — colloquial expression: 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧グルだ ('to be in on it with 〜').
